epics.title: Privacy Consent Management
epics.jtbd: When a visitor arrives on the site, I want to be asked for consent before any non-essential trackers load, so that my privacy preferences are respected and the site complies with ePrivacy regulations.
requirements: R1: Integrate an established Consent Management Platform (CMP) rather than a hand-rolled banner to manage user consent.
R2: Block all non-essential cookies and trackers from loading prior to explicit user opt-in.
R3: Provide consent controls where refusing consent is exactly as easy as accepting it.
R4: Record the user's consent choice persistently and provide a mechanism to revoke or change consent later.
R5: Comply with §25 TDDDG (German market) and ePrivacy Directive requirements for cookie consent.
R6: Configure realistic initial consent copy matching the product domain to ensure the interaction path is walkable on a fresh install.
R7: Update all existing end-to-end tests to explicitly accept or dismiss the consent overlay before interacting with underlying page elements.

slices.title: Implement CMP integration and tracker interception
slices.jtbd: When implementing the CMP UI for this epic, I want to integrate the consent platform and configure script interception, so that the privacy consent management outcome is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the user visits the site for the first time
When the page loads
Then the CMP banner is displayed before any non-essential tracker loads, it is fully usable on a phone screen, and refusing is as easy as accepting.
Given the user navigates the CMP banner
When using a keyboard or assistive technology
Then all controls are keyboard operable, have visible focus, are properly labelled, and maintain 4.5:1 text contrast.
Given the user interacts with the CMP
When they accept or reject
Then there is immediate visible feedback, the choice is recorded, and trackers load only if accepted.
Given a fresh deployment of the site
When the application starts
Then it loads realistic domain-specific consent copy to ensure the path is walkable.

slices.title: End-to-end verification of privacy consent flows
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA testing for this epic, I want to verify that trackers are correctly blocked and consent state is preserved, so that the privacy consent management outcome is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the E2E test suite starts a new visitor session
When the initial page loads
Then the test asserts that no non-essential tracker network requests are made before consent.
Given existing E2E tests are executed
When the consent banner appears as a global overlay
Then the tests explicitly accept or dismiss the overlay before interacting with underlying elements to prevent pointer interception failures.
Given a user has previously given consent
When the test uses the revocation control to withdraw consent
Then the test verifies the new state is recorded and future tracker loads are prevented.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: test flakiness rate on third-party domains
